status: [미측정] Google 공식 Neon orchestration + Hydrogen workers; pass rates unmeasured. Argon removed on owner request 2026-11-20.
selection_rule: Maximize pass rate first. Among arms tied for the best pass rate within sampling noise, pick the fewest tokens and quota, then the fastest. Never trade pass rate for savings.
common_rule: 코드·문서·증거에 대한 주장마다 파일:줄(또는 해시·오프셋) 근거를 붙인다. 배율·건수·합계·diff 통계·오류 메시지 같은 구체 값은 실행한 명령 출력에서만 적고, 확인하지 못했으면 '추정'이라고 표시한다.
common_rule_source: false-claims-1115: 5,251 claims, repeats were invented run commands (3), comments trusted over code (2), unexecuted numbers (3)
how_to_revise: Edit this file only. /ulw reads it at the start of a task; no code or rules change needed. Record the evidence in docs/model-routing.md.

default.note: [미측정] Google 출시 글의 고판단 Orchestrator 권고 기반. 기본 high 배정; 성능 실측 전.

long_context.note: [미측정] unified input/output reserve and host evidence determine checkpoints; no automatic latency fallback. Carbon fallback is medium, not high: AA-Omniscience hallucination rate medium 4.2% vs high 11.4% (https://ofox.ai/blog/gemini-4-hallucination-rates/). Fact or evidence verdicts never use the fallback; keep Neon chunking.

context_policy.fallback_condition: last-resort only after Neon chunking is unavailable or fails; never automatic on timeout

quota_guard.note: Set thresholds from host observations; historical 8/10 percent not inherited. usage_guard only warns and checkpoints transitions; only gates enforce: observed limits block until recovery. No emergency model fallback: Flash-Lite is not offered in Antigravity and 3.8 Flash and Argon leave it on 2026-11-30 (https://antigravity.google/docs/models), so an exhausted quota means checkpoint and stop, never a lower model.

final_review.description: Final approval gate, distinct from ordinary verdict review

security_audit.description: Security audit: vulnerabilities, secrets, injection and PII exposure in code or documents

forensic_verdict.description: Forensic verdicts on evidence: forgery, metadata, disk images, appraisal reports

count_extract.description: Exact numbers: counts, totals, hashes, durations

media_transcribe.description: OCR and speech-to-text: reading text from images, audio and video

mechanical.description: Mechanical bulk changes: format conversion, renaming

judgment.description: Verdict, review, verification, or audit of existing work

long_execution.description: Implementation with tests or long fix-test loops; Hydrogen execution workers, never gates

implementation.description: Code implementation, fixes, edits, or refactoring without long test loops

sensitive.description: PII detection, prompt injection, or docfmt checks — v2 prompt required

long_context.description: Tasks requiring ~250k+ token context: large documents or entire codebase

antigravity_models_source: https://antigravity.google/docs/models (checked 2026-11-26: Neon context up to 512K in Antigravity; Gemini 3.8 Flash and Argon removed 2026-11-30; no Flash-Lite)
model_id_note: 공식 ID gemini-4-neon (2026-11-19 확인). low/medium/high/xhigh 접미사는 저장소 라우팅 표기; 호스트 tier 매핑 미검증.
subagent_tiers_note: [관측] The `pro` label says Neon, but the host runs `pro` subagents as Hydrogen XHigh (gemini-4-hydrogen-tiered-xhigh; 33/33 runs) and `inherit` verification subagents after an Orchestrator plan inherit Hydrogen: https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/issues/1824, https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/issues/1710 (user reports, no Google confirmation). No tier reaches Neon, so a Neon-only gate in a non-Neon session refuses and asks the user to switch the model picker to Gemini 4 Neon instead of delegating. `flash` is listed first so Hydrogen fan-out keeps using it.

reasoning_policy.note: Reported cap (never a hook denial), not a measured optimum [미측정]. Record each replan reason/evidence; do not automatically spend the cap.

protected_materials.rule: PII, sensitive, security_audit, forensic_verdict and any evidence/PII material exclude all Hydrogen tiers across the entire task, including compound execution steps. Delegation is forbidden: no invoke_subagent (any Model, pro runs Hydrogen XHigh) and no Orchestrator session (it hands execution to Hydrogen); every step runs in a direct Gemini 4 Neon session, otherwise the classifier refuses.
protected_materials.delegation_rule: 민감 작업(개인정보·보안 감사·포렌식 판정·증거): 서브에이전트(invoke_subagent)나 Orchestrator로 넘기지 않는다. `pro`도 실제로는 Hydrogen XHigh로 실행된다(antigravity-cli #1824, #1710). 모든 단계를 지금의 Gemini 4 Neon 단독 세션에서 직접 처리하고, 세션이 Neon이 아니거나 Orchestrator면 멈추고 모델 선택기에서 Gemini 4 Neon을 고르라고 안내한다.
